name: sawaza-website
description: sawaza.app: the Sawaza marketing site, built with Astro from the approved design.

scripts.build:preview:prelaunch: SAWAZA_PREVIEW=true astro build --outDir dist-prelaunch && node tool/relativize.mjs dist-prelaunch
scripts.build:preview: PUBLIC_LAUNCHED=true PUBLIC_SHOW_ANCHOR=true SAWAZA_PREVIEW=true astro build --outDir dist-preview && node tool/relativize.mjs dist-preview
scripts.test:parity: PUBLIC_LAUNCHED=true PUBLIC_SHOW_ANCHOR=true astro build && node tests/parity.mjs
